name: Sanity MCP
description: Lets agents run GROQ queries, patch and publish documents, manage releases, and deploy schemas in Sanity projects over a hosted OAuth MCP server.

skills.name: GROQ Queries
skills.description: Runs GROQ queries against a dataset with query_documents and fetches single documents with get_document.

skills.name: Document Editing
skills.description: Creates, patches, publishes, and unpublishes documents, and discards drafts, with awareness of the deployed schema.

skills.name: Schema Deployment
skills.description: Fetches and lists deployed schemas, deploys schema types to the cloud, and deploys a managed Sanity Studio.

skills.name: Release Management
skills.description: Creates and lists content releases and creates document versions that belong to a release.

skills.name: Asset Uploads
skills.description: Uploads images and files from a public URL or a prepared one-use upload URL into a dataset or a Media Library.
